title: Hypixel 1.9+ item backport
description: Backports item models from 1.9+ to 1.8.9 in Hypixel
body:
**This pack requires Optifine!**

This resource pack adds models and textures for 1.9+ items in 1.8.9 for Hypixel.
This includes all modern textures in both Skyblock and Bedwars.

All textures and models are made by Mojang.
